(other) Concurrent resolution (no force of law): calls on Ohio's seventeen members of Congress to uphold federalism and to support appropriate action, including if necessary a constitutional amendment, affirming state authority over election processes and state power over campaign finance and election influence
(other) Clerk sends copies to the delegation and the news media
(other) note: Non-binding resolution; no voter ID, provisional ballot or proof-of-citizenship text. Sole version.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
